summary: Multi-conversations system for AI Chat - Local-first governed lifecycle
reason: Implement complete multi-conversations lifecycle à la ChatGPT/Gemini/Claude. Users can create new conversations, switch between them, view history, without context mixing or data loss. Architecture 4-Ring: Types (R1) → Engines (R2) → Services (R3) → UI (R4). Local-first localStorage persistence + append-only events. Integration with existing chatEngine/useChat/OMEGA pipeline.

types: Conversation interface (id, title, messages, status, timestamps, metadata)
ConversationLifecycleEvent (created, activated, message.appended, archived, updated, deleted)
engines: createConversation(): creates new conv with auto-generated title
setActiveConversation(id): defines active conv (1 at a time)
archiveConversation(): archives conv + deactivates if active
updateConversationTitle(): auto-generates title from first user message
Event system: addEventListener() for lifecycle events
services: initialize(): loads existing conversations + restores active
appendMessage(): adds message + updates title if first user msg
Event listener: handles lifecycle events → persists changes
chatEngine: getConversationId(): uses lifecycle.getActiveConversation() instead of Map
OMEGA pipeline receives correct conversation_id from active conv
Backward compatible with legacy Map approach (migration)
hooks: State: conversations list, activeConversationId, activeConversation, isLoading
Actions: createConversation, setActiveConversation, archiveConversation, deleteConversation, refreshConversations
Fallback: creates default conversation if none exist
ui: ConversationsButton: badge + icon for opening sidebar
Sidebar features: new conversation button, list with dates/counts, active highlighting, context menu (archive/delete)

proofs: chatEngine.ts imports conversationLifecycle correctly (5 integration points verified)
